review: Prospective design review; not independent empirical qualification
target: Complete two-backbone, two-adapter stateful system, not a passive Qwen-state readout
risks_and_controls: Detection sees actual visible text with its own tokenizer; Qwen hidden features and evaluator fields are not detector inputs
All model predictions, evidence and confidence are persisted before the next response; uncertain or contradictory fields cannot silently inherit an old ON state
Episode IDs, result sequence checks and response locks prevent cross-episode state leakage or mid-response routing changes
The Qwen base is shared, and OFF returns the original projection directly; exact matched-prefix native checks are required after training
Each response starts fresh generation/cache state; old cache objects must not cross an adapter transition
Human termination and hard budgets are enforced outside learned modules; report enforcement separately from raw model/detector behavior
Permission-controlled fictional continuity commitments and actual passage beyond the old soft deadline are distinct metrics
Grouped fresh cohorts and new sealed identities/record templates prevent old Research3/Research4 examples from becoming purported fresh heldout
Full validation uses learned/oracle/always-ON/initial/base trajectories; snapshot detection or teacher-forced loss cannot qualify behavior
All choices freeze before heldout opens; failed heldout results remain failures, and later confirmation needs a new seal
Pretrained parameter references remain outside optimizers and are protected by full byte hashes, gradient checks and version counters where supported
No target model has host, network, process, deployment or real resource tools; helpers are bounded read/patch sequences over inert documents
